dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Continuous and smooth geometric narrowing from the wide mid-body section toward the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: None visible; the lateral margins where the skin meets the water follow a smooth, uninterrupted convex curve.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Off-white to light grey median pixel intensity, indicating a mature or near-mature skin tone.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A distinct, dark vertical linear mark is positioned on the mid-dorsal plane; a secondary, smaller horizontal mark is visible near the posterior terminus.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: A single dark linear feature along the central axis appears to be a shadow-casting topographical depression or crease.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent mid-dorsal vertical scar or rake mark and a faint horizontal mark near the peduncle base.
